rules.title: Prepare for arrival
rules.description: Review practical steps for settling in Sweden before or soon after arrival.
rules.explanation: The respondent does not yet live in Sweden.

rules.title: Review residence guidance for your situation
rules.description: Review guidance for the selected origin category ({origin}) and purpose ({purpose}). These answers alone do not establish whether you need a permit or qualify to live in Sweden.
rules.explanation: The respondent has no current residence permit; origin and purpose may help find relevant guidance but are not enough to determine individual residence rights.

rules.title: Check eligibility and prepare a Personnummer application
rules.description: Review Skatteverket's current requirements for your situation and prepare the supporting documents before applying.
rules.explanation: The respondent lives in Sweden, has no Personnummer, and has not applied.

rules.title: Check your Personnummer application status
rules.description: If you have not received a decision, check the status with Skatteverket. Do not submit a duplicate application.
rules.explanation: The respondent has applied but did not say a decision is pending; check status without assuming the application is still waiting.

rules.title: Follow your Personnummer application
rules.description: Wait for the decision and contact Skatteverket if you need an update. Do not submit a duplicate application.
rules.explanation: The respondent explicitly says a decision is pending.

rules.title: Check Swedish ID card eligibility and application steps
rules.description: Review Skatteverket's current requirements before applying; eligibility is assessed for your circumstances.
rules.explanation: A missing Swedish ID card calls for eligibility and application guidance, not an assumed legal obligation.

variants.title: Check Swedish ID card eligibility
variants.description: Ask Skatteverket which identity documents and personal-number status apply to your circumstances before preparing an application.

prerequisites.explanation: A Personnummer may be relevant to the ID card process; confirm eligibility and timing with Skatteverket.

rules.title: Prepare to open a bank account
rules.description: Compare banks' current identity, documentation, and appointment requirements. A Personnummer or Swedish ID card does not guarantee eligibility.
rules.explanation: The respondent does not have a Swedish bank account; requirements vary between banks.

rules.title: Check BankID eligibility and setup options
rules.description: Ask an issuing bank about eligibility and setup requirements. Having a bank account does not guarantee BankID; ask about alternative access methods.
rules.explanation: The respondent does not have BankID; provider eligibility and prerequisites must be confirmed.

prerequisites.explanation: BankID is issued through banks; prepare to discuss account-opening requirements, but account eligibility does not guarantee BankID eligibility.
BankID's current eligibility guidance requires a Swedish personal identity number; confirm your circumstances with an issuing bank.
BankID's current eligibility guidance requires a Swedish personal identity number; confirm your circumstances with an issuing bank.

rules.title: Review your social insurance and coverage
rules.description: Check your registration and coverage situation with Försäkringskassan. Separately consider whether additional insurance suits your needs; private cover is not a universal legal requirement.
rules.explanation: The answer indicates no Försäkringskassan registration; it does not establish that the respondent lacks all insurance coverage.

rules.title: Find housing and review rental terms
rules.description: Compare housing options and understand the rental contract, deposit, and notice terms before signing.
rules.explanation: The respondent is still looking for housing.

rules.title: Plan your next housing step
rules.description: Review your current arrangement and decide whether you need longer-term accommodation.
rules.explanation: The respondent has temporary housing, so a follow-up plan may be useful.

rules.title: Get a Public Transport Card
rules.description: Purchase a regional travel card for the area where you live or travel. No other roadmap steps are required first.
rules.explanation: A regional travel card can be purchased independently of the respondent's other roadmap answers.

rules.title: Check rules for your EU licence
rules.description: Confirm the rules and conditions for your particular licence and issuing country with Transportstyrelsen.
rules.explanation: The respondent plans to drive and selected the EU licence category; the issuing country and individual rules still need confirmation.

rules.title: Check rules for your driving licence
rules.description: Ask Transportstyrelsen whether your particular licence can be used or exchanged in Sweden; rules vary by issuing country and circumstances.
rules.explanation: The respondent plans to drive and selected Other; no exchange or eligibility outcome is assumed.

rules.title: Check your Swedish driving licence details
rules.description: Keep your licence accessible and check that its details are current.
rules.explanation: The respondent plans to drive and reports having a Swedish licence.

rules.title: Review job-seeking support
rules.description: Review Arbetsförmedlingen's services and create a profile if appropriate for your situation.
rules.explanation: The respondent's stated purpose is looking for work.

rules.title: Review study and student support steps
rules.description: Confirm enrolment requirements and any support available through your education provider.
rules.explanation: The respondent's stated purpose is study.

rules.title: Review work and employment onboarding
rules.description: Confirm your employment documents, workplace onboarding, and practical arrangements with your employer.
rules.explanation: The respondent's stated purpose is work.

rules.title: Review family settlement needs
rules.description: Check which practical registration, childcare, school, or family-support steps apply to your household.
rules.explanation: The respondent's stated purpose is family.

questionnaire.guidance: These choices do not separately identify EEA or Nordic status. Nationality alone does not establish residence rights.

questionnaire.text: Do you already have a residence permit?

dependencies.explanation: Origin alone does not determine residence rights or whether a permit is required; check rules for your individual situation and purpose.

questionnaire.guidance: A No answer does not by itself establish that a permit is required; individual residence rights depend on more information.

questionnaire.text: Do you already live in Sweden?

dependencies.explanation: Ask about registration only when the respondent already lives in Sweden.

questionnaire.text: Have you applied for a Personnummer?

dependencies.explanation: The application status only applies when the respondent does not already have a Personnummer.

questionnaire.text: Do you have a Swedish ID card?

dependencies.explanation: Ask about identity documentation for respondents already living in Sweden.

questionnaire.text: Do you have a Swedish bank account?

dependencies.explanation: Bank requirements vary; the answer is useful even when the respondent lacks a Personnummer or Swedish ID card.
BankID eligibility depends on the provider and is not guaranteed by holding a bank account.

questionnaire.text: Do you plan to drive in Sweden?

dependencies.explanation: Licence information is only relevant when the respondent plans to drive.

questionnaire.guidance: This answer describes the licence category, not its issuing country. Origin does not establish which driving rules apply.

dependencies.explanation: Ask about Swedish social-insurance registration only for respondents already living in Sweden.
